title: The Equinox 2.0 - Overview & General Information

metadata.venue: Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship, MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana, India

content:
The Equinox 2.0 (2026) is the flagship annual entrepreneurship summit organized by the Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) at MLR Institute of Technology (MLRIT), Hyderabad.
Tagline: "Where Passion Meets Perseverance" (# WHERE PASSION MEETS PERSEVERANCE).
Dates: 30th & 31st October 2026 (30th & 31st October 2026).
Venue: Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship, MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana, India.
Host: Centre for Innovation & Entrepreneurship (CIE), MLRIT. Institution: MLRIT ("Engineering Ideas, Engineering Careers").
Audience: Over 1,000+ student innovators, builders, startup founders, strategists, and E-Cell leaders across campuses in India.
Highlights: 10 official sub-events, 2 action-packed days, 50+ college E-Cells participating.

title: Who We Are & What We Do - CIE MLRIT
content:
Who Are We:
The Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) at MLR Institute of Technology is dedicated to nurturing student innovators, startup founders, and forward-thinking leaders through hands-on entrepreneurship.

What We Do:
CIE MLRIT creates an ecosystem where ambitious students transform theoretical ideas into viable ventures through mentorship, seed support, hackathons, and industry networking.

What Is Equinox:
The Equinox is the flagship annual entrepreneurship summit organized by CIE MLRIT. A powerhouse two-day confluence uniting ambitious students, early-stage founders, angel investors, and tech pioneers across India.
The Equinox is designed to test grit, sharp business acumen, street hustle, and visionary thinking. Across two high-voltage days on 30 - 31 October at MLRIT Hyderabad, participants dive into 10 premier sub-events ranging from simulated live cricket bidding and Monopoly-style business conquer to high-stakes investor pitch decks. Whether you're marketing products on campus in Hustle Mania, dissecting corporate dilemmas in Crossroads, or defending your favourite enterprise in Brand Battles, Equinox is where collegiate passion transforms into real-world perseverance.

title: Registration Process & Summit Passes
content:
Registration Details for The Equinox 2.0:
Registrations for The Equinox 2.0 (30 - 31 October 2026) will open shortly. Reach out to our student coordinators or mail cie@mlrinstitutions.ac.in for team reservations.

Registration Steps:
1. Select Sub-Events: Pick from the 10 official competitions and exhibitions across tech, strategy, and business.
2. Form Your Team: Assemble your squad or enter solo depending on event criteria.
3. Submit Details: Register online or via CIE MLRIT campus desk.
4. Compete & Win: Arrive at MLRIT Hyderabad on 30 - 31 October to pitch, hustle, and conquer.

Summit Pass:
Full access pass for both days (30 - 31 October 2026).
Perks include: Access to all 10 sub-events, Startup Expo floor badge, delegate kit, participation certificates, and exclusive founder/mentor networking.
For team discounts or institutional group passes, contact student coordinators or email cie@mlrinstitutions.ac.in.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
Frequently Asked Questions about Equinox 2.0:

Q1: When and where is The Equinox 2.0 taking place?
A1: The summit is scheduled for 30 - 31 October at MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana.

Q2: How many sub-events are part of Equinox 2.0?
A2: There are 10 confirmed sub-events: Spotlight, Crossroads, Startup Expo, Brand Battles, IPL Auction, Hustle Mania, Internship Drive, Startup Poly, E-Cell Meet, and Pitch Deck.

Q3: Who can participate in Equinox 2.0?
A3: Students from any college, department, or year can participate. Diverse events cater to strategists, coders, marketers, cricket enthusiasts, and startup founders.

Q4: How can I contact the event coordinators?
A4: You can reach student coordinators Shyam (+91 93900 06806), Mahima (+91 94933 62006), Sanjana (+91 82084 99746), or Adithya (+91 91822 40970), or email cie@mlrinstitutions.ac.in.

Who Can Attend:
Students, innovators, developers, strategists, and aspiring startup founders from any recognized university or college across India can participate.
Events cater to diverse specializations including sales/marketing (Hustle Mania), strategy/case analysis (Crossroads), cricket strategy & finance (IPL Auction), venture pitching (Pitch Deck), tech trends (Spotlight), and gaming/monopoly simulation (Startup Poly).
